validity.recommendation: reclassify PipelineType as transmission (trunk отвод), not distribution
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records PipelineType=distribution for this row, but Gazprom's own official regional gasification map (gazprommap.ru/pskovskaya/, live 2026-09-15 and the 2022-07-19 archived capture) lists this exact object as 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС «Пустошка» Псковской области' (a газопровод-отвод — branch/lateral off the trunk — plus its terminal GRS), as a DISTINCT listing from a separate, later downstream object, 'Межпоселковый газопровод ГРС «Пустошка» – г. Пустошка' (the town-facing межпоселковый/inter-settlement distribution main running FROM that same GRS onward to the town). This is exactly the distinction this batch's brief describes: an отвод terminating AT a ГРС is the upstream/trunk-side asset (operated by a Gazprom Transgaz subsidiary, 5.4-7.5 MPa class), while the межпоселковый network downstream of the ГРС is the true distribution asset (operated by Gazprom Gazoraspredeleniye). P4166 is named 'Novosokolniki-Pustoshka' and ends at the Pustoshka GRS, matching the отвод (upstream/transmission) pattern, not the distribution pattern. No source explicitly uses the word 'transmission'/'магистральный', so this is a terminological inference from the отвод/ГРС vs межпоселковый naming distinction rather than a direct classification statement — recommend a human review before pasting the reclassification, but the current 'distribution' label looks wrong under the batch's own test.

Existence and status confirmed independently: Gazprom's own Pskov Oblast gasification-programme map (gazprommap.ru/pskovskaya/) names this exact отвод+GRS object ('Газопровод-отвод и ГРС «Пустошка» Псковской области'), still flagged 'done: 0' (not completed) in both the current live page (2026-09-15, now under the 2026-2030 programme edition) and a 2022-07-19 archived capture (then under the 2021-2025 edition) — i.e. the project has been carried forward across at least two programme cycles without being dropped, cancelled, or (per the map) completed. This independently corroborates the sheet's Status=proposed, ProposalYear=2021, and both endpoint locations (Novosokolniki and Pustoshka, Pskov Oblast). No duplicate-entity concern: P4166 is one segment of a genuine consecutive chain of Pskov отводы in this batch (Bezhanitsy-Novorzhev / Novorzhev-Pushkinskiye Gory / Pushkinskiye Gory-Opochka, and separately Pustoshka-Idritsa = P4167 immediately downstream of this row), each terminating at its own named GRS per the same gazprommap.ru list (point-25 Struzhi Krasnye, point-26 Идрица) -- not a double-count of any other roster row. Caveat: no independent technical specs (length/diameter/pressure/capacity/cost/start date) were recoverable for this specific object from any source reachable in this session -- the sheet's own two harvested wiki citations (pskov.ru sites/default/files/documents/2020/183d.doc and .../2022/35d.doc, territorial-planning-scheme amendments) both return HTTP 403 live and have zero Wayback captures under either filename (confirmed via CDX prefix search of pskov.ru/sites/default/files/documents/2020/* and .../2022/*), and this session's general-web-search tooling (WebSearch budget exhausted; Bing, DuckDuckGo and Yandex all returned bot-challenge/CAPTCHA pages to direct curl) could not substitute. The classification concern (PipelineType) is filed separately.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: LastUpdated on this row is 2023-07-31 (proposed, no ConstructionYear-implied progress noted). Newer dated evidence found: Gazprom's own Pskov Oblast gasification-programme map still lists this exact отвод+GRS object as incomplete as of 2026-09-15 -- three years after LastUpdated -- and shows it was carried forward from the 2021-2025 programme edition (per the 2022 archive) into the current 2026-2030 edition rather than being dropped or quietly completed. That is affirmative, dated evidence the project is still live and still not built, not mere silence, so this is 'confirm' rather than 'stale': the dormancy rule (proposed with no progress >=2y -> shelved) does not fit a project Gazprom itself just re-scheduled into its next five-year programme cycle -- being re-committed to a new programme edition is continuation, not abandonment. Searched for a status-changing event specifically (completion announcement, cancellation, or removal from the current programme): none found. Could not verify against the sheet's own cited pskov.ru planning-scheme documents (both 403 live, no Wayback capture) or via general web search (WebSearch budget exhausted this session; Bing/DuckDuckGo/Yandex all bot-blocked to direct fetch).
